galactus.surfer.name: Silver Surfer • Herald of Galactus
galactus.subtitle.herald: The herald has found your world.
galactus.subtitle.arrival: The Devourer of Worlds is coming.
galactus.subtitle.invasion: Break the anchors. Save your world.
galactus.dialogue.chosen: SILVER SURFER: Your world has been chosen. Galactus is coming.
galactus.dialogue.prepare: Prepare while you can. Your journal explains the anchors and three ways to stop him.
galactus.dialogue.redemption: SILVER SURFER: I will not sacrifice another world. Break his anchors and weaken him. I will open the rift.
